summary: Architectural plan to reorganize the dashboard layout and workstation navigation to faithfully match the user's sketch. Features a top bar with Light/Dark toggle on the left, central search bar, and Log-Out on the right; an Explorer sidebar with Dashboard, Courses, Assignments & Exams, Friends, and Settings; and a main dashboard featuring the full-width Incoming Deliverable banner, Degree Program & 3 Metric Chips header card, a left tabbed card switching between Active Courses and Sessions Logs with a contextual 'Go to Page' shortcut, and a dedicated right Quick Note taking panel with an embedded (+) Quick Action button.
